title: pm-dispatch: cut the fleet's token spend — merge `main` once before landing, `xhigh` only for design and re-reads, a one-page seat digest for card threads, longer idle patrols, dependent cards in series (Sales 2026-11-12)
body:
coordinator#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUGN2vQwKSwCWeBLFk

Filing gate: ③ 维护者直派 (pm rule changes, filed only because the maintainer named them; relayed by the project coordinator). One card on the maintainer's word 「只需要写一个总卡」: the five parts below land as ONE `domain:skills` PR, folded, one commit per part. Filed from project thread "立卡优化车队 token 消耗" (`cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuR9xNb5zw3ggkXxJhz6c1X9`, project chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu). ⛔ Not a claim.

Blocked-by: #32784

**Maintainer's words, verbatim.** Sales, project chat, 2026-11-12T21:46:16Z: 「任务很多，评估如何节约 token」. The project coordinator answered at 21:46:25Z with five proposals (quoted per part below) and said part 2 changes the 17:17Z effort rule and needs the maintainer's nod. Sales, 21:46:42Z: 「立卡优化」; 21:47:01Z: 「并且你立刻执行」; 21:51:05Z: 「只需要写一个总卡」. The maintainer's project already works by these five parts from 21:47Z (its seat brief); this card makes the skill say them for every project.

**Business reason.** The backlog is long and the fleet's token budget is the bottleneck. The five largest repeat costs measured in this project on 2026-11-12 buy no new correctness: a card thread re-merging `main` into an open PR and re-running the full local battery (#32577's card thread did it again at 20:36Z, about 2.5 h for one round); `xhigh` held for whole epic/p1 cards including plain coding; every card thread re-reading the whole skill at start; idle seats reading mailbox and PRs every hour; dependent cards open at once, each re-merging the same `main`. Not doing it: fewer cards land per day on the same budget.

## Part 1 — merge `main` into an open PR once, before landing; never chase it

Proposal: 「只在落地前合一次 main，中间不追。」

Governing text: AGENTS.md §10 already says it: "After the PR is open, merge `main` only on a GitHub-reported conflict, a `main`-caused CI red or a queue removal, then only the scoped re-checks; dogfood once, on the final head" (ruling 6160990111, #23390, letter A). The pm-dispatch text a seat writes dispatch orders from does not carry it: `references/landing-operations.md` 〈D〉 「每一棒都是一整圈:merge main + A 的四步 + 全套验证」 and the K bar 「K ≥ 15 … ⇒ 先 merge main 等重跑绿」 say when to merge, never when not to, and nothing scopes the local re-run after a merge. So briefs order "merge `main` again" before a re-read or a PR, and each merge re-runs `dispatch-gates --commands` (100+ gates) in full.

Wanted: a seat's dispatch order, brief or re-read request ⛔ never orders a proactive merge of `main` into an open PR. An open PR takes `main` only on a GitHub-reported conflict, a `main`-caused red, a queue removal, or the K bar at landing time; that merge is the one merge before landing. After it, the local re-check is AGENTS.md §10's scoped set; the full battery re-runs only on §10's overlap condition. 〈D〉's 「全套验证」 reads the same way.

## Part 2 — `xhigh` only for design, re-reads and red-line checks

Proposal: 「只在设计、复读和红线检查时用 xhigh，写代码和修门禁降到 high，nit 继续用 medium。」

Governing text: `references/execution-duties.md` 〈派发〉 effort lines, as #32784 / PR #32845 amend them (that PR puts epic children on the `xhigh` list and adds the three `medium` kinds). This part edits the same lines, hence `Blocked-by: #32784`.

Wanted: on a card the effort rule puts at `xhigh` (L/XL, `security`, p1, epic child, ADR, four-axis analysis), only these phases run at `xhigh`: the design step before code, contract review and every re-read of a head (red-line reads included), and red-line checks. Writing code and fixing gates run at `high`. Nit work stays `medium`. The dispatch order's `Container & model:` line names the split, and the card thread switches its own effort between phases. Unchanged: `max` only by a named word; the tier rules; seat sessions at `high`.

## Part 3 — one-page seat digest instead of re-reading the skill

Proposal: 「把共用的部分压成一页摘要，类似 _common-seat1.md 的做法，所有座位都这样做。」

Governing text: `references/dispatch-runbook.md` 〈卡线程〉 「开线程要重新克隆、重读技能与 `os-dev.md`」 and 「线程照读 `os-dev.md`」; `references/coordinator.md` 「规则住本仓,⛔ 不在项目指令里转贴」. Nothing names a digest.

Wanted: each project seat keeps one common digest for its card threads in the project's shared folder (this project's model: `briefs/_common-seat1.md`, about 40 lines): pointers plus the seat's standing working orders (gates, relay, PR body shape, report shape, maintainer rules). It names the `origin/main` sha of the skill it was written from and is refreshed when a skill PR lands on what it summarises. A card thread reads the digest, its own brief, the card and every comment, and `os-dev.md`; it opens a skill file only when a step names it. The digest is never a rule source: where it and the skill differ, the skill wins and the digest is fixed.

## Part 4 — idle seats patrol less

Proposal: 「空闲的座位把巡逻间隔拉长，或者有新信件再唤醒。」

Governing text: `references/seat-post-protocol.md` 「项目席巡查默认每小时(总监席无);… 放宽注由」; `references/execution-duties.md` 〈收集〉② 「在飞期间主巡检间隔 ≤45 分钟,待命期 60–70」; `references/seat-lifecycle.md` 「队列空是待命非退场 … 巡查跑到收班」. Relaxing is allowed but nothing says when, so idle seats stay hourly.

Wanted: a seat with no in-flight card or PR, an empty mailbox and no lane candidate at its last fire is idle; an idle seat stretches its patrol (suggested every 3 h; the maintainer's word may set it per project) and records the reason on its `Patrol:` stub line. Mailbox letters and PR events still wake it at once (the mailbox PR is subscribed). An idle fire that finds no new letter and no moved PR ends after that probe. The first wake with work restores the normal interval. Seats are still never stopped by "N fires without change".

## Part 5 — dependent cards run in series

Proposal: 「卡排队等同一个 main 时互相追合，会重复消耗。建议互相依赖的卡串着做，不同时开。」

Governing text: `references/execution-duties.md` 「同区域单跨轮硬串行」 and fold-or-serial (hot files only); `references/landing-operations.md` 〈C〉 parks a PR that needs an earlier PR as a draft with an expected-red list. Nothing stops dispatching a card whose PR depends on another unmerged PR, so both run, and every move of the upstream makes the downstream re-merge and re-run (this project, 2026-11-12: PR #32811 stacked on #32808).

Wanted: a card whose PR would stack on another open PR's branch, or carries `Blocked-by:` on an unmerged card or PR, is not dispatched (no card thread opened) until that PR merges, unless the maintainer orders a build-ahead for that card. 〈C〉's draft parking stays for a PR already written when its dependency appeared. The concurrency cap is unchanged.

## Acceptance

- The five parts are in the skill text, each with the maintainer's 2026-11-12 words as its source line; AGENTS.md is untouched (Part 1 only points at §10).
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` and `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` are green. Line budget, measured on `origin/main` c04aa295: `SKILL.md`, `execution-duties.md`, `dispatch-runbook.md`, `landing-operations.md` all at ceiling, headroom 0; each new line is paid by a deletion in the same file or by a ceiling raise of the measured increment citing this card's ruling record, as the ratchet's rule allows. ⛔ No re-wrap to find a line.

Reader who acts: the `domain:skills` seat (an os-dev on `.claude/**`, `references/**` and `SKILL.md`; the maintainer's standing word in this project puts skill-modifying cards on `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`; effort `high`, the seat's contract review `xhigh`).

Dedupe (open AND closed): `is:issue "merge main" in:title` → 35 hits; nearest #23390 (closed, ruled A: the AGENTS.md §10 rule Part 1 carries into the skill) and #31548 (closed: the K bar). `is:issue effort in:title` → 9 hits; nearest #32784 (open, PR #32845; Part 2 builds on it). `is:issue patrol interval` → 47 hits; nearest #25991 (closed: seats create their own hourly patrol). `is:issue idle seat patrol`, `is:issue card thread re-read skill digest`, `is:issue stacked PR dispatch blocker merged` → seat posts and unrelated cards only. **New.**

Clause-②: no · Metadata-protocol: none · skip-changeset (`.claude/**` is not published).

Suggested-grade: p2 · rules text only; a maintainer-directed rule the fleet's spend rides on (same grade as #32784).
